title: This or That?
description:
Arms suddenly jut out from a nearby hole, clutching a [gold]suspicious bag of riches[/gold] and a clearly [purple]cursed relic[/purple].

[jitter][blue]"This... or That?"[/blue][/jitter]
a scratched-up voice whispers from below.

options.title: That
options.description: Add [red]Clumsy[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Obtain a random [gold]Relic[/gold].

notes: The Gold reward for choosing 'This' is randomized between 41-69 each time the event is encountered. After either choice, follow-up text appears describing what happens: choosing 'This' results in a frantic struggle with a mysterious third hand, while choosing 'That' leads to ghostly laughter and fire before the entity vanishes.
